name: Topiramate
route_note: Oral tablets, sprinkle capsules, extended-release capsules and oral solution.
originator: McNeil Laboratories / Johnson & Johnson (Bruce Maryanoff, Joseph Gardocki)

discovery.by: Bruce Maryanoff and Joseph Gardocki, McNeil
discovery.note: A fructose derivative made in an antidiabetic programme, found active in anticonvulsant screening.

tagline: Anticonvulsant and migraine preventive that began as an antidiabetic lead
summary: Topiramate is a broad-spectrum anticonvulsant also approved for migraine prevention and, with phentermine, for weight management. Cognitive slowing, paraesthesia and teratogenicity limit its use.
mechanism: Topiramate has several actions: it blocks voltage-dependent sodium channels, enhances GABA-A receptor-mediated chloride currents, antagonises AMPA/kainate glutamate receptors and weakly inhibits carbonic anhydrase.
Carbonic anhydrase inhibition explains paraesthesia, metabolic acidosis and kidney stones; appetite suppression underlies its weight-loss effect.
uses: Focal and primary generalised tonic-clonic seizures

history.title: Discovery
history.detail: Maryanoff and Gardocki synthesise topiramate at McNeil.

history.title: US approval
history.detail: The FDA approves Topamax for adjunctive treatment of partial seizures.

history.title: Migraine prophylaxis
history.detail: Topiramate is approved for migraine prevention in adults.

history.title: Generics
history.detail: Generic topiramate becomes available in the US.

history.title: Oral cleft warning
history.detail: The FDA warns of an increased risk of cleft lip and palate after first-trimester exposure.

history.title: Qsymia
history.detail: Phentermine/topiramate extended-release is approved for obesity.

history.title: EU pregnancy prevention
history.detail: The EMA introduces a pregnancy prevention programme after data link prenatal exposure to neurodevelopmental disorders.

serious: Acute myopia and secondary angle-closure glaucoma

facts: Topiramate's word-finding and concentration problems are common enough to have earned the nickname 'Dopamax'.
